correctness.rationale: At corank 1 the symmetric adjugate is λvvᵀ and gradient w.r.t a_t equals λ[z^t](Σv_i z^i)². Singular on a_k=0 iff that square is a single monomial, so k even=2j, v=e_j, equivalent to jth row zero. Corank≥2 points singular automatically. On extra L_j the complementary minor B has explicit nonzero ±a_{j−1}^j a_{j+n}^{n−1−j} and hence generic corank1. Schur complement yields nondegenerate quadratic normal slice −det(B)rᵀB⁻¹r. Rank≤n−2 secant locus has dimension 2n−5, intersected with coordinate hyperplane at most 2n−6; extra L_j dimension n−2 gives codimension n−2 in Y of dim2n−4, so for n≥4 singular codimension≥2. Hypersurface S2 plus regular in codimension 1 gives integral normality. At n=3 even k=2 equation −a0a3²−a1²a4 irreducible nonnormal; for odd k=1,3 cubics have A1+A5 isolated points. Independently verified 10 exact complementary minor identities for n3..6 and cubic A5 coordinate change. No scheme-theoretic radical primary decomposition claimed.
